title.zh: 【Galaxy Digital 申请 OCC 联邦章程，设立国家信托银行】
title.en: 【Galaxy Digital 申请 OCC 联邦章程，设立国家信托银行】

current_state.zh: Galaxy Digital applied to the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to establish Galaxy National Bank, a New York-based federally regulated trust bank that would provide digital asset custody, trading, staking, and fiduciary investment services.
current_state.en: Galaxy Digital applied to the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to establish Galaxy National Bank, a New York-based federally regulated trust bank that would provide digital asset custody, trading, staking, and fiduciary investment services.
